newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar tightly mixed as NY stays steady.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar tightly mixed as NY stays steady.

text.p: London white sugar futures were reluctant to stray from the day's tight ranges as the expected downward correction in New York failed to materialise, traders said on Friday.

Earlier, market sources had said they valued the August/July arbitrage as a good buying opportunity as London was likely to lag behind any downward move made on the raws -- thus allowing the differential to widen.
But volume remained thin in London as spot August traded an inside day technically and retained most of the ground gained during Thursday's trade-led rally.
Technical analysts said they expected the upward momentum to continue for the time being as the position was well supported, not yet overbought and still holding above a three-month trendline.
But the strength in the spot month was not expected to last until expiry in July, they said, despite fears of tight seasonal supply.

At 1600 GMT August stood just 10 cents lower after trading in a tight $1.50 range. October was down 20 cents at $304.60 while further forward months were slightly firmer. Volume totalled a light 543 lots.
Paris trading was much the same as the morning with just 405 lots on the board, mainly in spot August.
August was up 80 cents at $313.30 and October was unchanged at $304.50.
